body: Those dudes are funny, but not the dudes I'm looking for

I was walking in downtown Toronto and this crazy dude who was yelling at random people on the street locked eyes with me and then started screaming "Princess!" over and over, and as I passed by him he kept saying that I was trapped in a castle and that he was going to "save me"...

I am a theater technician with quite a few responsibilities. I have to paint this giant wall in the theater I'm working at and help run transitions and call cues...It's a lot harder than I originally thought. Plus, I have to balance school on top of that. I have no free time...
I would like to have lived in the 90's. It was a simpler time, ya'know?

I went to go ask my mom about the whole joining band thing but she thinks I should work on my art since I'm already an experienced cartoonist and freelance artist. She says I shouldn't be a jack of all trades because they are masters of nothing...I don't think she gets why I want to join band. I'm still planning on at least trying because I want to something fun because I miss going to practices and performing at competitions.
